  April 13, 2017
The City of La Habra Heights complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you
require special assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s
office at (562) 694-6302.

Materials related to any items on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the
agenda packet are available for public inspection at the City Clerk’s Office at 1245 N. Hacienda
Road, La Habra Heights, CA 90631 during normal business hours.

PUBLIC COMMENT PROCESS

Each member of the public may speak for a total of five minutes on any action item listed on
the agenda or other matters within the Council’s purview except with regard to items listed as
public hearings. To speak in the Public Comment segment please complete and deliver a
speaker’s card to the Clerk prior to the call for public comments. You will be called to the podium
by name when it is your turn to speak.

During a Public Hearing: Each member of the public may also speak on each public hearing
item. Please provide a speaker’s card listing the public hearing by number and submit it to the
Clerk before the hearing is opened by the Mayor. Your speaking time will be limited to the
subject of the hearing. In general, speakers are given three minutes. However, the Mayor may
limit speaking time during public hearings if several people wish to speak.

Should you need to provide written documentation, please give the Clerk a minimum of NINE
(9) copies prior to the start of the meeting so the information can be distributed to the Council.

  VIEW THE CITY COUNCIL MEETING LIVE AT: WWW.LHHCITY.ORG
 NOTICE
If you challenge any action of the City Council in court, you may be limited to raising only those
issues you or someone else raised at the public hearing described in this notice, or in written
correspondence delivered to the City Council at, or prior to, the public hearing. (Govt. Code §
65009(b)(2))

8.  WARRANT REGISTER FOR MARCH 2017

9.  MINUTES: MARCH 9, 2017 REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING

  RECOMMENDATION:  Approve.

10.  BUDGET AMENDMENT FOR CAFR DEFICIT ITEMS

  RECOMMENDATION:  It is recommended that the City Council appropriate a
  total of $18,016.00 and distribute accordingly to each
  Special Revenue Fund to correct the deficit fund
  balances.

11.  AUTHORIZE EXECUTION OF CONTRACTS AND ANNUAL PURCHASE ORDERS
  FOR WEED ABATEMENT/TREE TRIMMING/TREE REMOVAL

  RECOMMENDATION:  It is recommended that the City Council:

  A.  Authorize the City Manager to execute Professional Service Agreements for
  Weed Abatement/Tree Trimming/Tree Removal with the four recommended
  companies, in a form approved by the City Attorney;

  B.  Authorize the City Manager to issue a purchase order for $75,000 total for weed
  abatement/tree trimming/tree removal work completed in FY 2016-17 under the
  Annual Weed Abatement program; and

  C.  Authorize appropriate budget amendments.

REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING AGENDA  4  APRIL 13, 2017
 12.  AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR TREE TRIMMING AND REMOVAL

  RECOMMENDATION:  It is recommended that the City Council award a
  contract to Mariposa Landscapes, Inc. in the amount
  of $17,988.00, authorize the City Manager to execute
  the contract in a form approved by the City Attorney
  and change orders in the amount of 10% of the
  contract value, and authorize staff to proceed with
  commencement of tree trimming operations.

13.  RATIFY AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR AHUACATE ROAD SLOPE REPAIR
  EMERGENCY SERVICES

  RECOMMENDATION:  It is recommended that the City Council:

  A.  Allocate $31,735 from the Gas Tax Fund 210 to fund the project;

  B.  Ratify the award of contract to G.M Sager Construction Co., Inc. in the amount of
  $28,280.00 plus 10% for change orders, and authorize staff to proceed with
  construction of slope repairs.

  -------------------------------- END OF CONSENT CALENDAR --------------------------------

15.  ORDINANCE AMENDING ABANDONED VEHICLES AND ON-STREET PARKING
  PROHIBITIONS

  ORDINANCE NO. 2017-____: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF LA HABRA HEIGHTS, CALIFORNIA AMENDING CHAPTER 6.5 OF ARTICLE
  6 AND CHAPTER 12.2 OF ARTICLE 12 OF THE LA HABRA HEIGHTS MUNICIPAL
  CODE REGARDING ABANDONED VEHICLES AND ON-STREET PARKING
  PROHIBITIONS

  RECOMMENDATION:  It is recommended that the City Council conduct
  public hearing, read by title only, waive second
  reading, and adopt, “An Ordinance of the City Council
  of the City of La Habra Heights, California amending
  Chapter 6.5 of Article 6 and Chapter 12.2 of Article 12
  of the La Habra Heights Municipal Code regarding
  Abandoned Vehicles and On-Street Parking
  Prohibitions.”

16.  ORDINANCE AMENDING THE OFFICERS AND DUTIES OF THE CITY COUNCIL
  AND THE DATE TO CONSOLIDATE THE CITY’S MUNICIPAL GENERAL ELECTION
  WITH THE STATEWIDE GENERAL ELECTION HELD IN THE COUNTY OF LOS
  ANGELES IN NOVEMBER OF EVEN-NUMBERED YEARS BEGINNING IN
  NOVEMBER 2022

  ORDINANCE NO. 2017-____: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF LA HABRA HEIGHTS, CALIFORNIA AMENDING CHAPTER 2.3 OF ARTICLE 2 OF
  THE LA HABRA HEIGHTS MUNICIPAL CODE ENTITLED CITY ADMINISTRATION
  REGARDING THE OFFICERS AND DUTIES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND THE DATE
  OF THE CITY’S MUNICIPAL GENERAL ELECTION IN ORDER TO CONSOLIDATE
  THE CITY’S MUNICIPAL GENERAL ELECTION WITH THE STATEWIDE GENERAL
  ELECTION HELD IN THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES IN NOVEMBER OF EVEN-
  NUMBERED YEARS BEGINNING IN NOVEMBER 2022

  RECOMMENDATION:  It is recommended that the City Council conduct
  public hearing, read by title only, waive second
  reading, and adopt, “An Ordinance of the City
  Council of the City of La Habra Heights, California
  amending Chapter 2.3 of Article 2 of the La Habra
  Heights Municipal Code entitled City Administration
  regarding the Officers and Duties of the City Council
  and the date of the City’s Municipal General Election
  in order to consolidate the City’s Municipal General
  Election with the Statewide General Election held in
  the County of Los Angeles in November of Even-
  Numbered Years beginning in November 2022”.

  -------------------------------- END OF PUBLIC HEARING --------------------------------
REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING AGENDA  6  APRIL 13, 2017
 ADMINISTRATIVE ITEMS

17.  DISCUSSION OF POTENTIAL ROAD PROJECTS TO BE FUNDED BY THE
  RESTRICTED FUND BALANCE

  RECOMMENDATION:  It is recommended that the City Council authorize the
  Public Works Manager to design a slurry/cape seal
  project, solicit competitive bids, and return at a
  subsequent meeting for award of contract.

18.  SELECTION OF FINANCIAL INSTITUTION TO PROVIDE BANKING AND MERCHANT
  SERVICES FOR THE CITY OF LA HABRA HEIGHTS

  RECOMMENDATION:  It is recommended that the City Council authorize the
  City Manager to enter into an agreement for banking
  services with US Bank.

19.  PROPOSED CITY POLICY ON USE OF PERSONAL EMAIL ACCOUNTS AND
  PERSONAL ELECTRONIC DEVICES FOR CITY-RELATED MATTERS

  RECOMMENDATION:  It is recommended that the City Council adopt this or
  a similar policy as a minimum requirement for
  ensuring that the City complies with the PRA when
  there are requests seeking public records on personal
  accounts and devices.

20.  FIRE STATION APPARATUS BAY REPAIR RESEARCH

  RECOMMENDATION:  It is recommended that the City Council the City
  authorize staff to spend up to $20,000 to hire a
  qualified Engineer/ Consultant to assess the structure
  and provide recommendations.

  -------------------------------- END OF ADMINISTRATIVE ITEMS --------------------------------

21.  INDIVIDUAL COUNCIL MEMBER INFORMATION ITEMS AND/OR REQUIRED
  MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS

  RECOMMENDATION:  It is recommended that the City Council approve
  meeting reports and receive general comments,
  announcements, and/or suggestions from Members
  of the City Council.

ADJOURN MEETING: IN MEMORY OF COMMANDER DONALD WEBSTER, LOS ANGELES
COUNTY SHERIFFS DEPARTMENT.
